details.contract:
app/src/shared/config.ts ends up exporting exactly:

export const PROFILES?  -> deleted, with the Profile type and isProfile
export interface Budgets { defaultTokens: number; maxTokens: number }
export interface AppConfig { dataDir: string; repoRoot: string; cursorKey: string; budgets: Budgets }
export interface LoadConfigOptions { argv?: readonly string[]; env?: Record<string, string | undefined>; cwd?: string }
export function loadConfig(options?: LoadConfigOptions): AppConfig
export function detectRepoRoot(cwd: string): string
export function flagValue(argv: readonly string[], name: string): string | undefined

Delete PROFILES, Profile, isProfile and AppConfig.profile. Delete every read of CODEGRAPH_REPO_ROOT, CODEGRAPH_DATA_DIR and CODEGRAPH_PROFILE; the only environment read left in this file is CODEGRAPH_CURSOR_KEY (and the injected `env` option stays for tests).

flagValue(argv, name) returns the value of `--<name> value` or `--<name>=value` and undefined when absent; a flag present with no value is resolved as undefined.

Resolution: repoRoot = flagValue(argv,'repo-root') resolved against cwd when present, otherwise detectRepoRoot(cwd ?? process.cwd()). dataDir = flagValue(argv,'data-dir') ? resolve(repoRoot, value) : join(repoRoot, '.codegraph').

detectRepoRoot(cwd) walks from resolve(cwd) upward: at each directory return it when join(dir,'.codegraph') exists, else when join(dir,'.git') exists (a file or a directory — linked worktrees use a file); stop after the filesystem root; return resolve(cwd) when nothing matched. Use node:fs existsSync and node:path only; no git subprocess. Keep the AppError on an unknown cursor-key problem out of this module (the cursor module owns the length check) exactly as today.

This task temporarily breaks the typecheck for app/src/index.ts and app/src/tools/index/manifest.ts; TASK-008 and TASK-007 repair them in this same phase. Do not edit those files here.

details.contract:
app/src/index.ts becomes the CLI composition root for tools. Required shape changes:

Imports: `import { type InputLiteral, parseArgs, parseCliArgs, usageOf, CliUsageError } from "#shared/cli/args";` and `import { EXIT_FAILURE, EXIT_USAGE, exitCodeOf, renderEnvelope, statusLines } from "#shared/cli/render";`. Delete the local InputField, InputLiteral, ToolArgs, matchesType, matchesItem, expectationOf and parseArgs.

Registry: RegisteredTool loses `readonly profile`; delete registerableTools; runMcp uses the TOOLS array directly (const byName = new Map(TOOLS.map(...))) and its mcp.ready log no longer prints `profile`.

main(mode, argv): calls loadConfig({ argv }); `mcp` and `worker` dispatch exactly as today; any other mode is looked up in TOOLS and dispatched to the new runTool; an unknown name writes `cgraph: unknown tool "<name>"` to stderr and returns EXIT_USAGE without printing usage text (app/bin/codegraph.ts owns the banner).

runTool(name, argv, config): looks the tool up; builds args with parseCliArgs(name, tool.input, argv) inside try/catch — on CliUsageError write error.message and error.usage to stderr and return EXIT_USAGE; then openStore(config); `refused` writes the error message and hint to stderr and returns EXIT_FAILURE; `absent` prints store.reason to stdout and returns 0 when name === 'status', otherwise prints renderEnvelope of a bootstrapping envelope built with the existing boundarySpec helper and returns EXIT_FAILURE; `ready` calls tool.handle({ ...store.context, log: scopedLog(name) }, args), writes renderEnvelope(route(envelope, name, store.staleReason)) to stdout and returns exitCodeOf(envelope). A handler throwing is caught, logged and returned as EXIT_FAILURE with the failure envelope printed, mirroring callTool.

runStatus: keep the mode, but build its lines with statusLines(envelope) instead of inline formatting. workerOptions: keep --mode and --force only; repoRoot/dataDir come from the config produced by loadConfig({ argv }). guardRoot's hint becomes "point --data-dir at this tree's own .codegraph directory" (no CODEGRAPH_DATA_DIR). The `--data-dir` flag is now real: it is parsed by loadConfig.

Do not change callTool, answer, route, openStore, guardRoot logic, the watcher startup condition or the MCP request handlers beyond the profile removal. No new file may be created here.
